scenario_1_adapter_missing_in_on_mode.description: Preflight ready, but shadow adapter is missing in ON mode

scenario_2_enqueue_rejected_or_uncomplet.description: Adapter exists, but observe_async rejects task or observation does not complete

scenario_3_observer_error_or_drop.description: Observer returns errors or drops tasks
scenario_3_observer_error_or_drop.outcome: VERIFIED_REJECTED (errors/drops tracked in stats, verdict != GO)

scenario_4_identical_error_payloads.description: OFF and ON both return identical error payload

scenario_5_synthetic_dispatch_with_obser.description: Valid fixture dispatch with completed observation

scenario_6_rank_comparator_permutations.description: Permuted hit ranks must trigger rank mismatch

scenario_7_raw_vs_normalized_payload_sep.description: Volatile dynamic fields (request_id, latencies) distinguish raw vs normalized equality

scenario_8_per_query_search_deadline.description: Hanging search call must be bounded by search deadline without process hang

scenario_9_offline_fixture.description: Offline fixture halts with BLOCKED_DEPENDENCY and 0 searches

scenario_10_online_fixture_independence.description: Online fixture does not break from hardcoded offline expectation

scenario_11_exception_state_restoration.description: Unexpected dispatch exception restores environment and cleans up resources

scenario_12_off_mode_isolation.description: OFF mode strictly does not invoke observe_async on adapter
scenario_12_off_mode_isolation.outcome: VERIFIED_ISOLATED (0 observer calls in OFF mode)
